## New Features

- This release adds all of the content we made for LT24 into the base mod:
  - Papyrus Canary & Papyrus Gonolek
  - Flowering Lilypad
  - Duckweed
  - White-Collared Oliveback
  - White-Winged Warbler

- Updated uk_UA translations (thanks @unroman!)
- Bumped Minecraft version to 1.21.1

releases.notes:
## New Features
* The mod now contains a new built-in resource pack: `Tropicraft Texture Update`!
  * This is a preview of the upcoming texture refresh for the mod, by the talented @HexabluDEV and Endergized.
  * This can be enabled in the Resource Packs menu, just like Programmer Art

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/61204705-78f2-4f89-a268-bd8655b48946)

## Changes
* Tropicraft leaves now decay when logs have been removed
  * By @bconlon1 in https://github.com/Tropicraft/Tropicraft/pull/602 - thank you! <3
  * All pre-existing leaf blocks in existing worlds will remain persistent
* Rainforest trees now have additional branches to ensure that all leaf blocks are within range of logs

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/61898885-5b66-4a45-b277-c5d5d2a26fcc)

* Added crafting recipes to convert Tropicraft Mangrove planks to Vanilla Mangrove planks
* Added crafting recipes to convert Tropicraft Jocote and Plantain planks to Vanilla Jungle planks
* Update uk_ua.json by @unroman in https://github.com/Tropicraft/Tropicraft/pull/592
* Create ru_ru.json by @mpustovoi in https://github.com/Tropicraft/Tropicraft/pull/575

## Fixes
* Tropical Fish in Koa Village tanks no longer despawn
* Bamboo Ladders no longer have a random offset
* Spider Monkey leg rotation has been fixed
* Exploding Coconut damage is now attributed correctly to the thrower

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tropicraft/Tropicraft/compare/9.7.3-1.21...v9.8.0-1.21
